rows.en: A kaiju that does little but sleep. Tough, but weak on offense. Its thunderous snoring is said to have caused a noise nuisance.
Armed with many weapons, including the Zaku Machine Gun Custom and Heat Hawk, but has the drawback of being unable to use multiple beam weapons at once.
A fly-featured kaijin. Controls opponents with drugs and can also burn them to death with white foam spat from its mouth.
A Dopant holding the memory of the Masquerade. Weak individually, but attacks enemies as a group.
A "space hunter" skilled at luring prey with its evaporation ray. Insect-like in shape. Highly intelligent, but weak in combat.
Successor to the Hi-Zack. Armed with a beam rifle and beam saber, and can now use multiple beam weapons at once.
Light on its feet and highly agile. Armed with a beam rifle, a beam saber, and a shield with built-in missiles.
Called the "devil-like kaiju". Its main ability is a blue heat ray spat from its mouth. Not very good at close combat.
A cyborg with spider abilities. Fires tough thread to snare enemies. The dart-shaped poison arrows it spits from its mouth dissolve whatever they hit without a trace.
A Dopant holding the memory of Sweets. Sprays a cream-like liquid to restrain foes, and can also fire the cream itself as bullets to damage a target.
Also known as the "Hallucination Alien". Not very strong in combat, it tried to achieve its goals through scheming rather than force.
A jellyfish-like kaiju that floats in the air. Spreads its tentacles and spins to create a huge typhoon. Its whip-like arms and the high-voltage electricity it discharges from its feet are powerful.
A failed Yummy made from chipped Cell Medals. Overwhelms foes with numbers and is often used to stall or keep enemies in check.
The form a Yummy takes just after being born when a Greeed inserts a Cell Medal. It can fight like this, but it has no special abilities and isn't very strong.
A bat-type cyborg. Besides its signature biting attack, it can also control targets at will.
A Dopant holding the memory of Magma. Gives off enough heat to melt steel buildings and fires fireballs from its body.

The rapidly grown form of the "Tigris Flower", which blooms only once every 100 years. Its weapons are a whip in the right hand and a sickle in the left. It also sprays a powerful misty corrosive fluid from its belly.
An insect-type Yummy created by Uva. Excels at aerial combat, attacking foes by scattering scales from the wings on its back.

A Choju fused from a swallowtail butterfly larva and a space kaiju. Its whole body is a weapon: it can use a flamethrower, launch the sword-like horn on its head, and even fire a flash-like "Shock Ray".
Besides common weapons like beam sabers, it uses special attacks such as "Sea Snake" and "Spider Web", giving it high capability in localized combat.

A female kaiju, Seagorath's wife. Normally gentle, but turns fierce during spawning season. Teams up with her husband Seagorath, making both of their horns glow to generate powerful electric discharges.
A male kaiju, Seamons's husband. Rushes to her side when she calls for help. Teams up with his wife Seamons, making both of their horns glow to generate powerful electric discharges.

As its nickname "Higher-Dimensional Predator" suggests, an extremely voracious kaiju. It preys on other kaiju, and even if the target is bigger than itself, it wraps it in its wing-like "mouth" and swallows it whole.
A rogue Imagin who schemes to form an evil organization, the "Negataros Army (Working Title)". Not only strong, but also cunningly sly.
The form Negataros takes by using a stolen pass. It closely resembles Den-O's Sword Form. Nega Form masters every mode of the Nega DenGasher.
A Dopant holding the memory of Weather. Controls the weather at will, wielding rain, wind, lightning and cold. Physically strong too, it presses foes with swift, efficient movements.
An Imagin materialized from the image of the Hare in the tale "The Tortoise and the Hare". Dazzles foes with its astonishing leaping power.

notes.note: Empuras, Agrissa, Birugamo, Gigantes Hades: not in glossary; romanized (appear to be Regis original bosses; same names in CharacterName table). Gigantes Hades matches Heaven/Hell siblings.
Kai suffix rendered as Custom (official EW names Heavyarms/Sandrock Custom).
One word in the description (evaporation ray 'luring' term) looks odd or mis-written in source; 'luring' is a guess.
Source has no punctuation between the flower sentence and the weapons sentence; split in English.
Kept 'Nega DenGasher' (Nega Densword/Gasher weapon); romanization of the weapon name.

report: 80/80 rows. New terms not in glossary: Empuras, Agrissa, Birugamo, Gigantes Hades, Super Crisis Fortress, King Dark, Imperializer, Alpha Azieru, Psycho Gundam Mk-II, Tigris Flower, Higher-Dimensional Predator, Nega DenGasher, rogue Imagin. Uncertain: 1.6 'luring', Regis boss romanizations.
